document_notes: Page 321 of PIR Volume I contains entry 1570, which discusses the status of Aurelius Petrus as a potential legatus Aug. pr. pr. of Arabia.

entries.relevance_notes: The entry explicitly discusses whether Aurelius Petrus was a 'legatus Aug. pr. pr.' or an equestrian 'praeses' of the province of Arabia.

segments.identification_and_sources: memoratur in t. Bostreno CIG 4649 = IGR 3, 1324, melius Princeton Univ. Syria 3 A 4, 239, 546: ἐκ προνοίας Αὐρ. Πέτρου τοῦ δια[σημ.] ἡγεμ(όνος) cet.
segments.offices_and_career: praeses (provinciae Arabiae) a. 173 aerae Bostrenae i.e. a. 278/279 p. C. Incertum utrum legatus Aug. pr. pr. fuerit an praeses dignitatis equestris.
segments.governorship_attestation: Incertum utrum legatus Aug. pr. pr. fuerit an praeses dignitatis equestris.
segments.prosopographical_commentary: The editor notes the uncertainty of his status, specifically whether he held the senatorial rank of legatus Augusti pro praetore or the equestrian rank of praeses (indicated by the restored title διασημότατος ἡγεμών).

The province_text 'Arabia' is correct, but the normalized_office should reflect the uncertainty in the text. The entry explicitly states 'Incertum utrum legatus Aug. pr. pr. fuerit an praeses dignitatis equestris.'
